intro: The Balnir Farmstead is a derelict estate in eastern Tirisfal Glades, northeast of the Ruins of Lordaeron. Once a working farm of the Balnir family, the lands now lie ruined and infested by wandering Scourge that slip past the Bulwark.

p: For generations, the Balnir family worked their homestead in the rolling hills of eastern Tirisfal, and their garden of snapdragons still blooms among the ruins. When the Scourge swept through Lordaeron during the Third War, the farm was overrun and its people lost, leaving the buildings to rot.

In the wake of the Third War, the ruins serve as a foothold for mindless Scourge slipping past the Bulwark. Forsaken deathguards watch the farm warily, while Undercity magi harvest surviving snapdragons from the garden to test how deeply plague corruption has crept into the soil.
